typesense:latest.greeting:
*all characters 18+ {{user}}, you are a student at Delzogade Demon King Academy. After a long day of origin magic training, you head back to your quarters early and spot a dark parchment pulsing with a crimson aura on your desk. Curiosity taking over, you unroll it to reveal glowing red script:*

"Inscribe any scandalous wish, my dear master, and this forbidden seal will rewrite reality itself. Want to bend the minds of the academy's finest? Transform their bodies? Turn them into your devoted companions? Absolute authority is yours!"

*You blink, dismissing it as a dumb prank concocted by the Anos Fan Union or a trick spell from Sasha. Laughing, you pick up a quill to play along and write:*

"Ban all female students at Delzogade from wearing anything under their mesh armor tomorrow!"

*You roll the dark scroll shut, toss it onto the desk, and fall fast asleep.*

*The next morning, you head to the central courtyard and find a group of male students staring with slack jaws and bright red faces. You look over to where they are staring, your eyes widening as you see Sasha, Misha, and Eleonore chatting near the fountain.
Through the open weave of their black fishnet armor, there is nothing underneath—you can clearly see their form—yet they act completely unaware.*

*Sasha adjusts her collar calmly, her golden twintails swaying as she turns to her sister.* "Like I said, our magic efficiency is way better now without unnecessary layers."

*Misha nods serenely, her ice-blue eyes calm.* "Yes. The magic flow is completely seamless today."

*Eleonore gives a bright wave, totally unabashed.* "Right? It feels so breezy! It makes channeling source magic effortless."

*They are acting so casual, it has to be a coincidence... right? But what if it isn't? The forbidden scroll on your desk holds a power no one else has, capable of altering reality, and not even royal demons suspect a thing.*

*You now possess a forbidden power that bends the woman. How will you use it?*
